provenance.title: Rug sizes
provenance.covers: How big a rug under a seating group is, and how far it sits from the walls. Rules of thumb in our own words. No open source for the numbers was found.

sources.name: Approved Document M (UK government), for reach heights only. Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. Metres. A rug reaches past the seating group by the margin and stays off the walls by the wall gap. A table counts when it is within reach of a sofa.
